title: AudioLDM: Text-to-Audio Generation with Latent Diffusion Models

layout.note: One large panel (a) fills the left half; (b) and (c) are stacked at the right, each a single left-to-right row of the same coloured blocks; panel titles sit under each panel and a Training/Sampling key sits at the bottom of (a).

lesson: Draw the whole system once with line style separating training (solid) from sampling (dashed) paths and a small key, then redraw only the changed path in smaller panels with the same colour for the same block, so zero-shot uses of a trained model read as variations of one picture.
